subject.title: fix(ui): new sessions remember valid workspace and model choices

question: Should the Control UI intentionally remember a browser user’s prior New Session workspace, worktree, model, and reasoning choices and make them the default for later drafts?
rationale: This is a new persisted user-preference mode, not a documented broken behavior, and it changes the default selections users see after their first explicit choice.

options.title: Sponsor browser-local restoration
options.body: Accept the per-browser preference behavior, require live connected-Gateway proof for restoration and stale-value fallback, then review a rebased head.

options.title: Pause pending product decision
options.body: Keep the linked feature discussion open and defer this implementation until an owner confirms the intended New Session defaulting policy.

recommendation.title: Pause pending product decision
recommendation.body: Keep the linked feature discussion open and defer this implementation until an owner confirms the intended New Session defaulting policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history ties steipete most directly to the proposed Control UI behavior, although final product direction needs an explicit repository decision.
